translations.web: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.
translations.bsb: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners will be your plowmen and vinedressers.
translations.kjv: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
translations.asv: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners shall be your plowmen and your vine-dressers.
